description: If prefix schemes \((u,t)\) and \((v,s)\) present \(A\le_{\mathrm{tt}}B\) and \(B\le_{\mathrm{tt}}C\), the specified composite presents \(A\le_{\mathrm{tt}}C\). Its bound is \(w(x)=\max(\{0\}\cup\{v(i):i<u(x)\})\); it constructs the inner answer word from the required prefixes before applying the outer table, and returns zero on supplied words of the wrong length.
